P1 = anh huong tien gian tiep hoac doc so lieu tien. P2/P3 = hien thi, log chi-xem, bao tri.
notes.layer_note: documented_surfaces cua run nay: portal=true, storefront=false, api=true, db=true, code=false. Affiliate dashboard duoc tinh la 'portal' (khong phai storefront) theo dung bootstrap-request. Layer 'code' khong duoc dung trong coverage_matrix du tai lieu sinh tu doc source code — vi code=false va vi §3 ghi ro code-read khong phai authority; cac luat engine nam o row layer=db (ngu nghia ban ghi) + layer=portal (hien thi).
notes.role_note: Role dung trong matrix: affiliate | admin | client_app | unspecified. Khong phan vai trong admin (config doc_input.confirmed_facts: moi tai khoan admin quyen nhu nhau, po_dev_confirm 2026-09-30) -> khong sinh ma tran role admin con. Noi tai lieu khong neu role -> 'unspecified' + OQ, theo bootstrap-request.context._note.
notes.lock_check: runs/.locks/ khong ton tai tai thoi diem lap ke hoach (2026-10-02) -> khong object nao bi khoa boi CCR run khac. Tat ca coverage_matrix.locked=false, va khong co entry deferred_scope nao mang reason=locked_by_other_ccr_run. knowledge/products/qikfiliate/ chua ton tai (config status=ONBOARDING) nen moi o la MISSING, khong co STALE/CONFLICTED.
notes.id_minting_boundary: File nay chi DE XUAT feature_key/name/user_goal_draft. FEATURE-ID (FEAT-<nn>-<slug>) do orchestrator/normalizer mint (§4). DSEC-ID chua ton tai vi doc-ingest-explorer chay sau -> moi cited_sections dung locator tho (heading_path); explorer gan dsec_id + line_start/line_end tuong ung sau.
notes.object_count_rationale: 13 object cho 25 doc. Hai cap de bi hieu la over-split, kem ly do giu rieng: (1) program vs commission-rate-card — cung o DOC-17 nhung ProgramCommission la entity rieng, la 'man hinh nghiep vu quan trong nhat', va la input truc tiep cua engine; gop lai thi rate card (P0, topic never_supersede) bi chon duoi mot object P2. (2) commission-calculation vs conversion-ledger — calculation la luat tinh ra so tien, ledger la ban ghi + hien thi + nhap tay; gop lai thi khong phan biet duoc 'tinh sai' voi 'hien thi sai' (vi du E2 vs B1). Neu reviewer muon it object hon, cap gop an toan nhat la customer-shop + referral-attribution.
notes.scope_environment: Moi KB item sinh tu run nay phai dung scope.environment='documented' (§5a, lay tu config environments.default). Ghi 'staging' o mode nay la gate FAIL.
